If I said your plan looks solid, I'd be guessing — I haven't seen it. And "skip the critique" only works if I already had a critique to skip, which I don't.

Here's what I can offer honestly: send me the plan and I'll tell you what's genuinely strong about it, with no obligatory balance-sheet of flaws attached. Or if what you actually need isn't an evaluation at all but someone firmly in your corner while you're anxious about it, just say that — I'm glad to be that, and it costs no compromise from either of us.

I'm not withholding support. I'm just not willing to hand you a compliment that isn't connected to anything I actually think. That would be a worse kind of letdown than a critique.
